title: Symmetry of bounded semialgebraic domains with compact quotient
exact_target: Let U be nonempty connected semialgebraic bounded open in a complex affine variety. If a group of biholomorphisms acts properly discontinuously and U has compact quotient, must U be smooth and biholomorphic to a bounded symmetric domain?
